verdicts.reason: Both use the same jumbled leaderboard layout. The RSVP button has shrunk to a pill the same size as the Free Entry, All Ages and Tastings tags, so the CTA is buried. The reading order is scrambled: the time and venue sit far left, 'Reserve a spot' is placed above the tagline on the right, 'Solstice Presents' is tiny, and a stray red fragment dangles after Tastings. The logo is clipped against the left edge in both. A's logo is noticeably oversized and competes with the headline, and B's smaller logo is slightly better proportioned, so B wins by a hair.
